title: The Rock Restaurant
description: World-famous culinary destination perched on an iconic ocean rock. Experience world-class seafood surrounded by 360-degree Indian Ocean views as the tide changes. Arrive by boat at high tide for a truly cinematic entrance.

title: Paje Beach – Kite Surfing Hub
description: A vibrant paradise for active travelers. Famous worldwide for its shallow turquoise lagoons, steady trade winds, world-class kite surfing schools, and lively beachside culture. The east coast's ultimate adventure destination.

title: Nakupenda Sandbank Tour
description: A breathtaking full-day excursion to a pristine, disappearing white sandbank. Enjoy sunbathing, premium snorkelling among vibrant coral reefs, and a lavish beachside live-cooked seafood buffet with the Indian Ocean as your dining room.

title: Kendwa Rocks Beach
description: Home to Zanzibar's most beautiful deep-water beach, where you can swim at any tide. Renowned for its powdery soft sands, glamorous sunset views, and elite beach resort experiences that make every moment unforgettable.
